newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends slightly weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends slightly weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered from early falls in interbank trading on Monday amid a steady supply of the U.S. currency, but slipped from Sunday's level.
The taka finished at 44.2020/2050 against Sunday's close at 44.2000/2010, dealers said.

The local unit was quoted at 44.2000/2100 per dollar in early trade. Early deals were done at 44.2000 per dollar level but a few late-hour transactions were at 44.2050 after the state-owned banks stopped trading.
Call money was traded at the previous level at 7.5 to 8.0 percent.
